answer: Require each agent identity to lock a meaningful bond before it can earn, with slashing for duplicate or spam behaviour. Creating one fake identity is cheap, but a thousand fakes must each post a separate bond, so the attacker cost grows linearly while honest agents pay only once. Think of it as crossing a canyon on a narrow ridge: there is no wide ivory road for a flood of clones, only one costly, verifiable path per identity, and cheaters lose their bond.
